rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun, especially when discussing an interview in a news, research, or professional context.

example.english: The interviewee in this study is a retired person.
example.traditional: 今次研究嘅受訪者係一位退休人士。

rows.note: Use this straightforward spoken description when you want to make clear that the person is the one answering the questions.

example.english: The interviewee has to fill out this form first.
example.traditional: 接受訪問嘅人要先填呢份表。
